name: equity-research-core
description: 8 equity-research dimension skills with ~48 addressable sub-prompt modes, backed by agentii.ai's data API (SEC filings, XBRL facts, earnings calendar). Each skill covers one analytical dimension: recent-quarter performance (dim-1), competitive landscape (dim-2), growth strategy (dim-3), secular tech trends (dim-4), turnaround analysis (dim-5), risk analysis (dim-6), earnings sentiment (dim-7), valuation methods (dim-8).
